text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After going out with Mejiro Ardan,
I glance at my watch.
It's still a bit early to head back, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...If you'd like,
would you care to take another detour with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's good. Well then,
where shall we head today—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Ardan-san and Trainer-san!
Good afternoon!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, Spe-san and Oguri-san.
Are you two heading out somewhere as well?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Today I'm on my way with Spe to that ramen shop,
"Extra Thick Noodles Hammer Bolt."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hammerbolt... What a unique name for a shop.
choice_data_list: Since we're already here, wanna go check it out?
Since we have the chance, wanna go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Leaping into the unknown is the real charm of taking detours.
As a self-proclaimed expert, I simply can't pass this up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then... would you mind
if I joined the two of you?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we ended up heading to a ramen shop called "Extra-Thick Noodles: Hammer Bolt," but—

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Extra extra veggies,
extra extra fat,
strong flavor, garlic!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Triple extra pork,
extra fat, light on garlic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What could this be?
These words flying around since earlier,
sounding almost like a magical incantation...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: For me, make that extra-extra veggies, extra garlic, extra backfat, extra tare sauce, and quadruple pork chashu!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll take an Obuta Quintuple with all the extras extra-extra-extra-extra-sized, Mariana Trench Olympus Mons great eruption style, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Both of you too...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmhâ¦â¦ Ardan, could this be your first time in a shop like this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, then should I give you a quick rundown of the terms?
Their specialty here is braised pork, and instead of meal tickets, you order verbally—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—No. I appreciate the thought, but
this is all part of the detour... As an advanced user,
I must at least manage the ordering on my own.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Customer C
text_block_list.text:
Extra extra veggies,
extra pork quadruple!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Customer
text_block_list.text:
Veggie Chomolungma,
extra extra extra fat!
Extra pork quintuple!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I am beginning to understand.
'Yasai' and 'Ninniku' are toppings.
And 'Mashi' signifies an extra portion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...And 'quadruple' and 'quintuple' specify the complexity
and richness of the broth used.
Much like a quartet or a quintet...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: On top of that, the reason she's shouting the names of mountains... is to express a grand, expansive flavor that brings those majestic landscapes to mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand... what everyone's words mean!
I can do it! An order that's mine... mine alone!
—Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Extra veggies,
light garlic,
sextuple giant pork.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure about that, Ardan-san?!
The veggies and stewed pork look like some kind of ancient ruins...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Pushing yourself too hard is no good.
If you'd like, we can lend a hand too.
Besides, that combination piques my interest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —This is the monster I have summoned. What in the world should I do—?
choice_data_list: First, you gotta give it a shot!
First, you gotta give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—This is the monster I have summoned.
What in the world should I do—?
choice_data_list: First, you gotta give it a shot!
First, you gotta give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Being able to eat delicious food
without pushing yourself is the best!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Besides, no matter how piled-high the toppings are,
I was just thinking one bowl felt a bit lonely anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... if we do that, it feels like
I'm just pushing my own mistake onto the two of you...
choice_data_list: The whole point of a detour is to have fun, right?
The whole point of a detour is to have fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. It is just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then, if you wouldn't mind...
we would appreciate your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thanks to the two of you, it was delicious. Thank you so much♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you, it was delicious!
6x Extra Pork really is quite the spectacle!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that was a satisfaction I'd never experienced before.
I'll have to try copying that next time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment I wondered how things would turn out, but—
it seems this little detour has ended up as another fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. To lay this to rest,
none other than I, who ordered it, must be the one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know when my stomach
will reach its limit... but still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will focus solely on the single bowl before me.
Right here, right now... I stake everything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now—here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And though Mejiro Ardan took on the challenge boldly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I-Im-possi-ble!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To end up defeated by the very monster I created—
what a tragic conclusion."
